description: Detect a trusted enrolled person's voice when they call the user and notify direction through smart glasses and phone cues.
customer_segment: Smart-glasses users who want subtle awareness cues from trusted people nearby.
core_job: Tell me who called me and where to look without forcing me to check my phone.
mvp_scope: Speaker profile states for label simulation versus on-device voice embedding readiness
Enrollment sample quality capture without raw audio persistence
Embedding verifier contract for future on-device speaker matching
Prototype enrollment embedding reference generation without PCM persistence
Prototype live voice match diagnostic without alert delivery
Local event history without raw audio
excluded_scope: Guaranteed front/back direction before hardware proof
Glasses-side haptics before official API confirmation
success_metrics: Detection latency under 1.5 seconds in controlled tests
False positives below 1 per hour in quiet indoor tests
At least 80 percent left/right accuracy on supported hardware
No raw audio leaves the phone by default
